step1_figure.circuit_type: CMOS Differential Amplifier with Current Mirror Load
step1_figure.description: Figure 22.6 on page 716 shows the differential amplifier with an active PMOS current mirror load (M3, M4) and cascode tail current sink, and Figure 22.12 on page 720 details the complete implementation biased by the wide-swing cascode bias circuit of Figure 20.47 (subcircuit SUB_1).

max_input_cm_voltage.description: Maximum input common-mode voltage keeping input diff-pair in saturation

equation.explanation: Limited by the condition that input transistors M1/M2 must not leave saturation (V_DS >= V_GS - V_THN), where drain potential is VDD - V_SG.
equation.assumptions: M1/M2 identical, PMOS current mirror in saturation

sky130_expected.calculation: With VDD = 1.8 V, V_THN = 0.42 V, and |V_ovp| ≈ 0.14 V giving V_SG = |V_THP| + |V_ovp| = 0.42 + 0.14 = 0.56 V: V_CM,MAX = 1.8 - 0.56 + 0.42 = 1.66 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by supply rail minus PMOS diode drop plus NMOS threshold.

max_output_voltage.description: Maximum output voltage swing before active load enters triode region

equation.explanation: Limited by the PMOS current mirror load transistor M4 remaining in saturation.

sky130_expected.calculation: With VDD = 1.8 V and V_SD,sat = |V_ovp| ≈ 0.14 V: V_OUT,MAX = 1.8 - 0.14 = 1.66 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Output can swing within one PMOS saturation voltage of VDD.

min_output_voltage.description: Minimum output voltage swing before input transistor enters triode region

equation.explanation: Determined by gate voltage of M2 such that M2 remains in saturation (V_D2 >= V_G2 - V_THN).
equation.assumptions: M2 in saturation without significant body effect

sky130_expected.calculation: For nominal common-mode input V_I2 = 0.9 V and V_THN = 0.42 V: V_OUT,MIN = 0.9 - 0.42 = 0.48 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Directly tracks input DC voltage minus the NMOS threshold voltage.

min_vdd.description: Minimum allowable power supply voltage for proper diff-amp operation

equation.explanation: Sum of diode voltage across M3, saturation voltage across M1, and saturation voltages across cascode tail current source.

sky130_expected.reasoning: V_SG of the PMOS mirror load is the dominant factor setting headroom.

equation.explanation: The differential voltage gain with a current mirror load is gm times the parallel combination of output resistances of M2 and M4.
equation.assumptions: Small differential input signal, current mirror unity reflection

sky130_expected.calculation: At ID = 10 uA: g_m = sqrt(2 * un*Cox * (W/L) * ID) ≈ 232 uA/V (for W/L=10/1). r_o2 = 1/(0.1*10u) = 1 MOhm, r_o4 = 1/(0.1*10u) = 1 MOhm. r_out = 500 kOhm. A_d = 232 uA/V * 500 kOhm = 116 V/V ≈ 41.3 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Typical single-stage active-load diff-amp gains on bulk CMOS range from 30 to 45 dB.

cutoff_frequency_3db.description: 3-dB corner frequency driving a load capacitance

equation.explanation: Dominant pole set by the high output impedance of the current mirror diff-amp and load capacitance.
equation.assumptions: Output node dominates frequency response; C_L = 1 pF

sky130_expected.calculation: With r_out = r_o2 || r_o4 = 500 kOhm and C_L = 1 pF: f_3dB = 1 / (2 * pi * 500e3 * 1e-12) ≈ 318 kHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: High-impedance output node creates low-frequency dominant pole.

equation.explanation: Common-mode gain inversely proportional to the output resistance of the tail current source R_o and load transconductance g_m3,4.
equation.assumptions: Symmetric diff-pair, finite tail output resistance R_o

sky130_expected.calculation: For cascode tail R_o ≈ 5 MOhm and g_m3,4 ≈ 142 uA/V: |A_c| = 1 / (2 * 142e-6 * 5e6) = 7.04e-4 V/V ≈ -63 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: High output resistance of cascode tail strongly suppresses common-mode variations.

equation.explanation: Ratio of differential gain to common-mode gain expressed in decibels.
equation.assumptions: Low-frequency operation before source node capacitance reduces tail impedance

sky130_expected.calculation: CMRR = A_d(dB) - A_c(dB) = 41.3 dB - (-63 dB) ≈ 104.3 dB (with simple tail R_o ≈ 500k: CMRR ≈ 84 dB).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Cascode tail biasing provides high CMRR at low frequencies.

input_referred_offset.description: Systematic and random input-referred offset voltage

equation.explanation: Mismatch in threshold voltage and transistor geometry referred to the differential input.
equation.assumptions: Devices in saturation with small percentage mismatch

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming Delta_VTH ≈ 2 mV and 1% geometric mismatch with (V_GS - V_THN)/2 ≈ 43 mV: V_OS ≈ 2 mV + 0.43 mV ≈ 2.5 mV.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Typical CMOS diff-pair matching yields 2 to 10 mV input-referred offset.

input_referred_noise.description: Input-referred thermal noise voltage spectral density

equation.explanation: Total noise current PSD from input pair and mirror load referred to the input by dividing by input transconductance squared.
equation.assumptions: Thermal noise dominant at high frequencies, gamma = 2/3

sky130_expected.calculation: S_v = (8*k*T*(2/3) / g_m1) * (1 + g_m3/g_m1). With g_m1 = 232 uA/V, g_m3 = 142 uA/V: S_v ≈ 1.54e-16 V^2/Hz. Spot noise = sqrt(S_v) ≈ 12.4 nV/sqrt(Hz).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by NMOS input transconductance and PMOS load noise contribution.

step3_testbench.description: Comprehensive ngspice testbench measuring DC transfer/swing, AC differential gain, 3-dB bandwidth, common-mode gain, CMRR, and input-referred noise.
